toKind.description:
The type of the destination of the reference. Note that this may be built documentation (type, topic, etc) or
it may be a file in the package (poly test, notebook) or even an external URL.

toName.description:
The path name of the destination of the reference.

This contains the parent if the kind needs to be qualified.
For example, fields will include their containing type as in `TypeName#fieldName`.

anchor.description:
The anchor of the link. This can be any span, including with nested markup. Note that #text will be the plain
text extracted from the anchor.

titleText.description: The title text for the link (if any).

title: An inline reference to a piece of structure to be rendered as a link.
name: DocumentationReference
